markets.question: Xi Jinping out before 2027?
markets.description:

CCP General Secretary Xi Jinping will be considered removed from power if he announces his resignation from his role as General Secretary, or is otherwise dismissed, detained, disqualified, or otherwise loses his position or is prevented from fulfilling his duties as General Secretary within this market's timeframe.

The resolution source for this market is the Associated Press, Fox News, and NBC. This market will resolve once all three sources call the race for the same candidate. If all three sources haven’t called the race for the same candidate by the inauguration date (January 20, 2029) this market will resolve based on who is inaugurated.

eventMetadata.context_description: JD Vance holds the top position in the 2028 presidential nomination market due to his vice presidential role and established Republican base, yet the field remains fragmented with Marco Rubio close behind on foreign policy credentials and Senate experience. On the Democratic side, Gavin Newsom leads a crowded group including Jon Ossoff and Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez, driven by fundraising, media visibility, and early travel to battleground states ahead of the 2026 midterms. Trader consensus reflects an open contest more than two years out, with no dominant polling average or primary endorsements yet; upcoming confirmation hearings, legislative votes, and candidate positioning in swing states could shift probabilities as primary season approaches in 2027-2028.
